title: w-3fe8 H5: a legacy unmarked queued prompt becomes a never-runnable hand-off after restart (FIFO break or stranded entry)
outcome: After a restart, a legacy queued prompt that is not Engram-retained loads as runnable and dispatches in FIFO order in every session. Only Engram-retained entries without a known promotion disposition fail closed as unknown hand-offs; no gate or grant is revived.
acceptance: Load restores master's ordinary semantics on the w-3fe8 candidate: an entry without a known disposition is failed closed as an unknown hand-off ONLY when it is Engram-retained (hand-off, bind or evaluate envelope, interrupted, or waiting) and its transcript position is unknown after eviction; ordinary and legacy entries load runnable, with file:line

A deterministic test: a legacy unmarked ordinary queued prompt in a session with an evicted transcript head survives reload and dispatches in FIFO order before a later entry, and the orphaned-workflow barrier still counts it; a retained legacy entry with the same shape still fails closed and is never replayed
The fix lands inside the w-3fe8 final candidate through its review pair and full gate, with no gate, grant or latch revived
disposal_reason: BY DESIGN, per Fable2's ruling (C) (#3885/#3886). 'Unknown is never replayed' is the reviewed w-ba8d contract. Witness 1: master engram_human_review_regressions.rs human_prompt_ordinary_fallback_refuses_unknown_disposition_handoff_or_replaced_owner, case 'missing_disposition', refuses a plain unmarked ordinary head in the OFF lane. The w-3fe8 candidate deliberately extends that to all sessions. Witness 2: c3ea engram_human_review_regressions.rs unknown_queue_history_projects_uncertainty_and_only_resumes_a_known_unsent_successor ('unknown_disposition'). Also tests/engram_retained_disposition.rs trimmed_unknown_promotion_stays_unknown_and_never_replays. The broadening comes from recovery slice w-14df8701db1f (recovery-r4.json patch lines 15283–15328, 'never replay missing evicted evidence'). Restoring runnable behaviour (option A) carries a duplicate-send risk. The affected population is narrow: pre-2026-09-22 rows still queued with an evicted transcript head. They load visibly as Ambiguous and are neither lost silently nor sent twice. The trial edit in .tmp/wt-h5-8111 was REVERTED (persisted_state.rs is back at blob 656dea03); nothing was frozen, committed or handed. The refinement for sessions with no Engram history is filed as Low w-147112cc0fba.
